history.contentIn: Wake up, people! The so-called Stratospheric Controlled Perturbation Experiment (SCoPEx) is just another cover for the insidious geoengineering agenda! Despite their claims that it’s harmless, releasing even tiny amounts of calcium carbonate into our atmosphere is a dangerous experiment we cannot ignore! The fact that they had to suspend tests due to public backlash shows how precarious their plans are. This isn’t about cooling the planet; it’s about weaponizing the weather!
